Help for this screen HKS-08
What it is for
The inspection checklists by room type and task type, their items with weights and critical flags, and the pass mark. Rules on the second tab say which rooms are inspected.
How it works
1. Press Items on a checklist to see its items. 2. Add or change items; mark the ones that fail the room as Critical. 3. To change a checklist that is in use, press New version, edit the draft and Activate it. Pass mark changes need approval.
Opened from
Housekeeping Setup Home (HKS-01) › Inspection checklists
Leads to
HKS-P08 Checklist Form, HKS-P09 Checklist Item Form, HKS-08-2 Inspection rules, HKS-O02 Checklist print
Sends to
Inspection queue and inspection (HK-08, HK-09) and the Housekeeping phone app
Note
Static screen (HTML and CSS only): it shows the layout, fields and sample data. Saving and live data come when the backend is connected.
